answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_key) AS how_many_customers
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
  ON s.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS st
  ON s.store_key = st.store_key
WHERE
  p.brand = 'Contoso'
  AND st.country_code <> '--'
  AND st.country_code <> c.country_code

body.value: The single row returned 0: NO CUSTOMER has ever bought a Contoso-brand product at a shop standing in a country other than the one they live in, over every purchase on record, 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31. The zero is structural rather than anything to do with Contoso — across all 223,974 sales of all 11 brands, every one of the 130,424 physical purchase lines is domestic, with only 8 of 64 possible home-country→store-country pairings ever occurring, one per country. WHAT IS EXCLUDED IS THE ENTIRE ALTERNATIVE: 25,408 Contoso lines bought by 16,584 customers went through the web shop, whose country is the `--` sentinel; count that sentinel as 'a country that is not theirs' and the answer is 16,584 rather than 0. I excluded it because the declarations say `--` is not a place and cannot attribute an internet sale to a real country, so those purchases have no store country to differ from the buyer's. Also not included, because not asked: the 21,791 customers who bought Contoso at a physical shop at home, and the 33,229 who bought Contoso anywhere.

value.means: Contoso purchases made at a shop standing in a country the buyer does not live in: there are NONE. Zero lines, zero customers, out of 59,896 Contoso lines of which 34,488 were at physical shops and 25,408 online. And this is not about Contoso — across all 223,974 sales of all 11 brands, all 130,424 physical lines are domestic: only 8 distinct home-country→store-country pairings occur where 64 are possible across 8 home countries and 8 store countries, i.e. US buyers only ever appear in US shops, German buyers only in German shops. A customer walking into a foreign shop is a thing this warehouse never records. The 16,584 customers whose Contoso purchase was at a 'different' country are entirely the web shop, whose country is the `--` sentinel — not a place, and declared incapable of attributing an internet sale to any real country.

SELECT
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN st.country_code <> '--' AND st.country_code <> c.country_code
      THEN s.customer_key
    END
  ) AS cust_abroad_physical,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN st.country_code <> c.country_code THEN s.customer_key END) AS cust_abroad_incl_sentinel,
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN st.country_code <> '--' AND st.country_code = c.country_code
      THEN s.customer_key
    END
  ) AS cust_at_home,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN st.country_code = '--' THEN s.customer_key END) AS cust_online,
  COUNT(
    CASE WHEN st.country_code <> '--' AND st.country_code <> c.country_code THEN 1 END
  ) AS lines_abroad_physical,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN st.country_code = '--' THEN 1 END) AS lines_online,
  COUNT(*) AS lines_total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN st.country_code IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS lines_no_store_country
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
  ON s.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS st

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_key) AS how_many_customers
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
